scope: Supplement to124 class/form candidates:6 Bard cards from its separate structured schema,7 feat objects and2 frozen supporting paragraphs. Preserve all Bard resource/recharge/Crescendo fields. Ordinary spells and semantic supplements still needed; no completeness/approval claim.

card.name: Lingering Notes
card.duration: While known; individual riders last as stated
card.effect: When a sustained Chant ends before its final scheduled pulse, mark one ally affected by its last pulse. At the start of your next turn, if that ally is within 30 feet and can hear you, it gains C temporary HP for 1 round. This residual note restores no HP, uses no concentration, and triggers no other Bard effects. Silence or incapacitation cancels it; only one residual note can wait at a time.
card.crescendoRider: Not a started Performance; no Crescendo rider.
card.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Lingering Notes: Chants last 1 extra turn after being interrupted.

card.designNote: Exact quantities, timing and restrictions are new playtest specifications; preserve the original text for comparison.

prerequisites.additional: Only the activation conditions printed in this card and the common rules.

card.name: Chant of Renewal
card.target: One living ally per pulse, including yourself
card.effect: On starting and on each paid maintenance pulse, one living ally within 15 feet regains 1d6+C HP. You may choose a different ally each pulse. There are at most 3 pulses, including the initial pulse. A creature can benefit from this named Chant only once per round across all Bards. This never removes Wounds or restores life.
card.crescendoRider: The initial recipient also gains C temporary HP for 1 round; subsequent pulses are unchanged.
card.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Chant of Renewal: A sustained melody that heals nearby allies for a small amount each turn while maintained.

card.name: Inspiring Performance
card.target: Up to three allies chosen on start
card.effect: Choose up to three allies within 30 feet. For up to 3 Bard turns while sustained, each gains +1 to attack rolls, AC and saving throws while within 30 feet and able to hear you. Bonuses from multiple Bard performances of the same type do not stack. Pay 1 RP and a Bonus Action on each later turn to maintain it; there is no extra Action grant.
card.crescendoRider: The chosen allies also gain C temporary HP until the start of your next turn.

card.name: Harmonic Resonance
card.target: 10-foot-radius fixed zone, up to three creatures per pulse
card.effect: Create one fixed 10-foot-radius zone within 30 feet, choosing Ward or Discordant mode on start. At the initial pulse and each paid maintenance pulse, Ward grants up to three allies in the zone C+S temporary HP until the start of your next turn; Discordant makes up to three enemies attempt Wisdom saves, taking S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. Mode is fixed for the use. At most 3 pulses; this is not a Chant and is not Echo-eligible.
card.crescendoRider: On the initial pulse only, Ward adds C temporary HP or Discordant adds 1d6 damage to the roll. This rider does not repeat.
card.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

sourceObject.description: Under the moon's gaze you bind flesh to curse through rites older than the cities of Aethel. Prestige lineage: Mooncursed. completed from the existing development record.)

sourceObject.name: Necrotic Affinity
sourceObject.description: Death's chill is an old friend on Aethel's battlefields—you channel grave-cold through fist and focus without flinching, as if the Binding left a door ajar in your marrow. Prestige lineage: Gravetouched. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You have resistance to necrotic damage. Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, you can deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. When you take necrotic damage from a spell or supernatural effect, you can use your reaction to absorb half of it (rounded down) and add that amount as temporary hit points until the end of your next turn. Creatures you kill with necrotic damage cannot be raised by effects of 5th level or lower for 24 hours.

supportingSources.text: Roll once for each shared area/pulse and apply saves/defenses to each target separately; separate attacks roll separately. Halve once for a successful save and apply resistance/immunity normally. Same-named conditions/bonuses do not stack unless a printed cap allows it; same-stat flat bonuses from these class techniques use the strongest. Different resources remain separate. Damage reduction from these class features uses the strongest flat reduction, then applies resistance; it cannot create negative damage or healing. Temporary HP never stack; choose the larger remaining amount. Immunity is not reduced resistance.

Repeated permanent HP recovery must consume finite RP, a per-rest use or another finite resource; a combat-generated gauge alone never enables unlimited healing. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP or erase Wounds, death consequences, debt or Corruption unless explicit. Downed is living at 0 HP; dead is different. Resurrection requires a willing soul and sufficiently intact body, obeys its time window, cannot create a duplicate and never refunds the feature on failure to meet known prerequisites. Sacrificial HP is actual unpreventable loss, cannot be redirected or paid with temporary HP, and is not damage for resource triggers. It cannot reduce the donor below 1 unless a card expressly grants a death-triggered effect.
